summary: Code review of useMatchmakingQueue hook and HomeScreen Quick Play additions. No critical or blocking issues. State machine transitions are correct, cleanup is thorough (interval + DELETE on unmount), and the implementation follows existing ModeCard/apiFetch/haptics patterns precisely. Accessibility is solid with role=dialog, aria-modal, assertive live region, and 48px touch targets. Three informational notes: (1) poll interval continues during app backgrounding (server handles gracefully via 300s TTL), (2) join() not debounce-guarded but overlay prevents re-tap and server handles 409, (3) no client-side timeout timer but server expired status covers this.
goal: Review 1v1 Quick Play implementation for correctness, conventions, and edge cases

learnings.insight: The polling interval continues during app backgrounding (visibilitychange not observed). For a 2s poll this is acceptable since the server handles idle polls cheaply and the queue has a 300s TTL, but a future optimization could pause polling when document.hidden.
learnings.action: Consider adding visibilitychange listener to pause/resume polling if battery impact becomes a concern.
